title: kbgit.py sync retries a push the forge refuses with a 5xx after a short backoff
goal: kbgit.py sync --push tells a forge-side refusal with an HTTP 5xx (remote: ... Internal API error (503), pre-receive hook declined) from a gate or race refusal and retries that push a bounded number of times after a short backoff, naming each try, so a passing landing is not stopped by a passing forge outage; seen in SP-ilqhjn3k, where GitLab's pre_receive endpoint answered 503 to three sync pushes in a row with every local gate green, and a hand loop pushed on its next try
